spec.title: What does robustness to manufacturing tolerance cost, and does optimising for it change the structure?
spec.hypothesis: Optimising the truss in robust mode (every design must stay feasible in at least 95 % of +/- 2 % perturbations, 12 perturbed copies per evaluation) yields designs whose independently measured feasible fraction is far higher than the nominal optimum's, at a mass cost of a few per cent rather than the uniform thickening the baseline would need; the member-surrogate method keeps its advantage in robust mode.
